steps.comment: Phase B of the reload round-trip: the save written by reload_roundtrip_save, loaded fresh. Probes only — nothing here links anything, so everything asserted below was rebuilt by CompBillGroup.PostMapInit reinstalling the field redirect during the load. Needs Tests/run_roundtrip.sh, which copies the save into the harness's Fixtures/ between the two runs. No screenshot: what this proves is that two benches point at one BillStack object, and no frame can show that. The falsifiability evidence is the control run in run_roundtrip.sh's header instead.

The load-bearing one. Bill counts alone would pass on two benches that came back holding separate deep-loaded copies of the same three bills, which is precisely the failure a missing redirect produces.

What a follower's inspect pane tells the player, as opposed to what the anchor's comp holds. These disagreed until the mode line was made to read the anchor: every non-anchor bench in a round-robin group said 'in order'.

The third frame, in a second game load: the same bench, the same three bills, rebuilt by PostMapInit rather than by anything in this scenario. Reference equality is what the probe above proves; this only shows the player-visible half survived.
